# AgentOre v0.0.3

AgentOre v0.0.3 turns the macOS menu extra into a compact live mining dashboard.

## Highlights

- New AgentOre token identity, macOS app icon, and matching menu bar icon.
- Lifetime Codex token usage is visible directly in the menu bar.
- The expanded menu shows daily epoch progress and a live countdown to the next automatic submission.
- The local wallet card shows the full address, Base ETH gas balance, and AORE balance.
- Automatic Base Mainnet submission is enabled by default, including a one-time migration for earlier app configurations.

Automatic submission requires Base ETH in the dedicated local wallet. AgentOre usage remains self-reported and the app stores its generated wallet key locally; read the repository security documentation before use.
